svg.aria-label: A shared session: the host sends terminal state to a viewer, which draws it locally
svg.title: A shared session: the host sends terminal state to a viewer, which draws it locally
svg.desc: A desktop window, the host, owns the PTY. It sends cells, styles and the cursor, not pixels or video, over the tailnet on truffle to a phone, the viewer, which draws the terminal itself. Viewers are read-only unless the host allows typing.
